The Roubic Beachwood Story

Caring for Beachwood's Canopy Since 1982

Beachwood has been a Roubic market for over three decades — the family has worked this affluent inner-ring Cuyahoga suburb since Roubic Tree & Landscape grew out of its Auburn Township roots in 1982. The heritage oaks, mature maples, EAB-risk ash, and original-growth pines that make Beachwood look like Beachwood are exactly the trees we work on.

Beachwood is a split market: the Chagrin Boulevard / Cedar Road corridor is one of NE Ohio's highest-value commercial districts, while the residential neighborhoods carry dense 50-to-80-year canopy. We know which streets the city allows access on and which neighborhoods carry tree-protection rules — the tree care has to fit the place.

Beachwood homeowners take their canopy seriously, and so do we. Owner-supervised crews, ANSI A300 standards, and equipment we own outright — that's how we've kept this market for 40-plus years. {{global.owner_name}} · Owner

Permit coordination in-house. Beachwood's tree-protection ordinance requires a permit for protected trees above the city's DBH threshold — Roubic files and closes it as part of the removal scope.

Common Beachwood Questions

Beachwood Tree Service FAQ

Six things Beachwood homeowners want to know before booking.

Do you serve Beachwood, OH?
Yes — Beachwood is part of Roubic Tree & Landscape's Tier 2 service area, roughly 10 miles from our Auburn Township yard. We've served Beachwood since 1982. Call {{global.phone}} for a free estimate.
How quickly do you respond in Beachwood?
Tier 2 markets like Beachwood receive next-day response on standard scheduled work and a 2–4 hour target on emergencies dispatched from Auburn Township. For 24/7 storm emergencies, call our emergency line and you'll reach a real person who dispatches the crew.
Do I need a tree-removal permit in Beachwood?
Yes — Beachwood has a tree-protection ordinance that requires a permit to remove a protected tree above a specified DBH threshold on both residential and commercial properties. Hazard trees follow an expedited process. Roubic routinely handles the full permit workflow as part of the job.
How much does tree removal cost in Beachwood?
Tree removal in Beachwood typically runs $200–$10,000+ depending on size, species, access, and permit fees. Small trees under 20 ft start around $200–$500; mature 50–80 ft trees run $1,500–$3,500; very large heritage estate trees needing crane assistance can exceed $10,000. Every estimate is free and quoted on-site.
What tree services does Roubic offer in Beachwood?
Beachwood receives three dedicated service lines: tree removal, tree trimming & pruning, and stump grinding. Land clearing and firewood delivery are available across NE Ohio through our all-services hub, and commercial accounts along Chagrin Boulevard are welcome.
When can you prune oak trees in Beachwood?
We follow a strict oak-wilt seasonal calendar and do not perform oak pruning between April 1 and July 31, when the disease spreads most easily. Oak work is scheduled outside that window, or handled sooner only when a tree is hazardous and removal is warranted.
